rationale: The standard-lesson input gate is satisfied by one academic and one learning-design advisory artifact against the same original candidate, across two distinct disclosed runs and providers. This recomputation is an internal consistency and operator-attested transport determination, not proof of independent providers or runs. The academic reviewer requested three material corrections; all were incorporated without changing lesson identity, version, status, unaffected teaching, or the review artifacts. The learning-design reviewer approved, and its two actionable minor findings were incorporated while its three positive findings required no change. Static checks of the resulting pack found coherent calculation logic, aligned claim/source-note mappings, parseable JSON, string-valued acceptable responses, conforming reference fields, accessible source-level alternatives, complete facts-only rights records, no third-party assets, and no active or private content. The stated verification limitations and the learning review's principal-level conflict and lack of real learner testing are preserved below. With the operator conditions completed, no credible unresolved academic, learning-design, accessibility, rights, privacy, security, or provenance blocker remains.
dissent: The academic reviewer returned request-changes on the original candidate because the clinical scene conflated a concentration relation with a unit conversion, overstated dimensional analysis, and omitted claim mapping; all three findings are incorporated in the final revision.

The learning-design reviewer approved but disclosed that VSBDev operated both authoring and review agents, that no real learner testing occurred, and that no rendered, screen-reader, or keyboard pathway was tested. Those limitations remain and are not represented as independent human verification.
